applied.fact: Date of the Elwha road washout

pro_tips: Most efficient as part of a multi-peak Elwha/Seattle Basin outing
Carry navigation tools for the trail-less terrain
Since the 2024 Elwha road washout, the North Fork Quinault River Trail to Low Divide (~16 mi) is now considerably shorter than the Whiskey Bend approach (~28 mi plus a 7-mile road walk)

before.beta: There is no maintained trail to Ruth Peak. Parties reach the Bailey Range crest cross-country (commonly via Appleton Pass, Cat Basin, and Ferry Basin/Eleven Bull Basin, or historically from the Elwha side), then scramble class 3 terrain to gain the summit from the ridge. The peak sits between Mount Carrie and Mount Fairchild, with small pocket/cirque glaciers (including the Fairchild Glacier) tucked beneath its steep gendarmes near Stephen Lake.
